description: Phase 09 Prompt 29 — hallucination risk checks. A read-only, advisory measurement over the deterministic retrieval corpus that scores hallucination-risk and overconfidence indicators (how risky the corpus is to present as fact), for human awareness. Hallucination-risk indicators: unsupported claims (fabrication), tier-3 items presented as fact, stale/conflict items, coverage gaps, degradation mode. Overconfidence indicators: high confidence assigned to weakly-grounded items (tier-3 / unsupported / stale-or-conflict), and a high-confidence-tier-3 mismatch count. It computes a deterministic risk band (low/medium/high) with an indicators list. It makes NO determination and blocks nothing — it scores risk only. assembles_final_answer is always false; persists nothing (no DB writes); metadata-only (counts, bucketed bands, distributions, family names, indicator flags — no raw content/source ref).
